title: Crying Eye of Cinema
description: A surreal portrait of a sorrowful woman with closed eyes and tears streaming down her face, adorned with a crown of red and blue flowers. A large stylized eye with concentric rings emerges from her right side, connected by flowing tendrils, while a film strip with anchors spirals through a swirling cosmic background of vibrant nebulae.
